results.note: Ukrinform (15 Nov 09:16 Kyiv) repeats the Air Force morning summary: from 18:00 on 14 Nov Russia launched 132 drones (Shaheds incl. 78 jet-powered, Gerberas, Parodiya decoys), below 170.

No on-record date for the next trilateral round was found for 14-15 Nov: TASS (Lavrov, 15 Nov; Lantratova, 16 Nov) and Witkoff's 12 Nov statement speak of a new round agreed but give no date, and the edition itself noted none was set.

ČT24/ČTK (15 Nov) report the organisers saying, with reference to the police, that about 400,000 people attended, and ČTK (16 Nov) gives the organisers' figure as 350,000-450,000; either reading is at least 300,000.

ČT24/ČTK (15 Nov): Minář declared from the stage a nationwide "výstraha" (warning) on Wednesday 2 Dec at 16:36, asking people to hang signs in windows and to go and question ANO politicians and voters; read as a dated coordinated protest action called by Milion chvilek (akin to a warning strike), though its forms are individual, so ambiguous.

CTP-ISW Iran Updates of 15 and 16 Nov record the Bahraini interception of the 14 Nov IRGC drone attack and Saudi interceptions but no CENTCOM, Pentagon or White House statement of a US strike or interception on 15 Nov (Tehran time); none was found on the CENTCOM press page either.

The CEC results page (pvgagauzia.cec.md) renders only by script, so from Europa Liberă (15 Nov) quoting the CEC and Wikipedia's results table: Stoianoglo 38.44%, Fiodor Gagauz 24.22%, turnout 37.6% above the 25% threshold, runoff on 29 Nov.
Europa Liberă (15 Nov) quoting the CEC and Wikipedia's results table: Stoianoglo 38.44% against 24.22% for Fiodor Gagauz, a lead of 14.22 points, above 10.0.

The CNE results page renders empty to a script; Inforpress (16 Nov) reports the CNE preliminary results credit Neves with about 64%, and Wikipedia's table gives 63.98% to 31.39% for Joana Rosa, so he was re-elected in the first round.
The vatican.va Spanish text of the Malecón Puerto Callao meeting (Pucallpa, 15 Nov) contains "las heridas de la deforestación indiscriminada" (English: "indiscriminate deforestation").

The vatican.va English text of the Pucallpa meeting says "the pollution of rivers and other waters through illegal mining", which the criterion accepts; the Spanish original says "extracción minera irregular", which alone would not have counted.
Digital Trends and Lowyat.NET (14 Nov) quote @MSFT365Status on 14 Nov at 06:09 UTC, after the 04:18 UTC freeze: "restored service to the remaining impacted customers and regions" for MO1550821.
cbs.gov.il unreachable; Globes ("Inflation unexpectedly falls sharply", 15 Nov 18:45) and Calcalist/CTech (16 Nov) report the CBS October CPI at -0.1% m/m and 12-month inflation at 1.1%.
Gasspeicherkarte.de (source GIE AGSI+, gas day 14.11.2026, provisional) shows 57.3% (141.8 of 247.4 TWh), with the two-decimal value 57.32% in its fill bar; the AGSI+ API needs a key.
